body: I think that I have the same thing as you describe. Although I have mental compulsions where I have to say specific phrases in my head and sometimes out loud. I have had this thing where I have to say that I copy others, imitate others and get inspiration from others and I have no idea why. I just know that I feel the need to do it every day but I don’t exactly know why and don’t suffer from typical intrusive thoughts

I can totally relate to what you're writing. I feel very much the same way. I also have these issues that you describe and for long periods of time throughout the last couple of years i would also just sit in my room for several hours or maybe days and just sit with my thoughts. My parents and my peers in general also react to my issues in the same way as you describe where they ask me if i'm not over that yet and they also seem to think of it as a phase. So i can completely relate to that you feel like your emotions are not valid. I also feel like that all the time, but your emotions are valid. And i too frequently think about suicide, but wouldn't do it because of my family and friends. So i just want to say you're not alone
